scenes.headline: How a fast image generator can drop its noise schedule
scenes.sub: Iterate on the picture, not on the noise
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Riffle! Fast image generators take about four steps, at noise levels picked by hand. This paper drops those noise levels entirely.

scenes.text: Between calls, pass the generator its own clean guess and the original noise, and let it improve that guess.
scenes.say: Between calls, hand the generator its own clean guess and its starting noise, and ask it to improve the guess.

scenes.title: What crosses the gap between calls

left.title: Flow space
items: A noisy image at a chosen time
left.say: Today's generators pass a noisy image between calls, at times fixed before training. A new schedule means a new model.

right.title: Data space
items: A clean guess plus the original noise
right.say: Data space iteration passes a clean guess and the original noise. The only clock is a step counter.

steps.say: Each call gets the same starting noise, and its current guess, which begins blank.
The generator is the teacher network with one extra input and a step counter.
It outputs noise minus its prediction: a finished picture after every call.
In training, a teacher and a fake copy disagree wherever the picture is wrong.
Then the better guess goes back in. No fresh noise, so nothing right gets thrown away.

scenes.title: The whole update
scenes.text: next guess = z - g(guess, z, r)

parts.say: Noise minus predicted velocity is the teacher's own jump to a clean image.
The previous answer rides along as an input.

parts.note: a step index, not a time
parts.say: A step index replaces the timestep.

steps.say: Same noise in every row. Data space keeps the same goldfish and adds detail.
Flow renoise repaints the scene each call.

scenes.title: Four calls, uniform schedule, no guidance
scenes.say: At four calls, data space reaches two point four six, against two point five five and two point seven five. Against the best searched schedule, it is about a tie.

scenes.text: What you pass between calls is a design choice. A clean guess needs no noise schedule.
scenes.say: What you pass between calls is a design choice. Pass a clean guess, and the schedule goes away.

recap: Pass the clean guess, not a noisy image
Same noise and a step counter each call
Same training loss, no schedule to tune
scenes.say: Pass the clean guess. Keep the noise and a step counter. Keep the training loss. Lose the schedule.
